summary: Planban 2.0.0 adds Online Boards: take a board online to share it, open it in any browser or on your phone, and connect ChatGPT and Claude. Local boards stay free and need no account.
updatePrompt: Update Planban from planban-ai/planban. Verify version 2.0.0, the installed plugin, and MCP tools; open an existing Board and confirm it remains readable and writable. This release adds dependencies, so a clean dependency install is expected. Reinstall the plugin after refreshing the marketplace so cached skills, hook scripts, and MCP instructions are updated, then start a new session. Nothing goes online unless the person takes a board online.
